note: an unauthenticated listener on the configured agent port receives repeated XRCE agent-discovery submessages from the flight controller, in a session with no client key; no credential, key or challenge precedes them. We did not answer, so no session was established and no topic was read or written.
why_it_matters: this is a second control plane that reaches uORB directly, and a MAVLink signing key does not apply to it: provisioning SETUP_SIGNING protects MAVLink links only. A deployment that has 'enabled signing' may still expose this path.
not_measured: whether a full agent could then read or write uORB topics (not attempted: that would require answering)
DDS-Security (the OMG standard) is not implemented by micro XRCE-DDS in PX4; we did not test it
whether a remote (non-loopback) peer can reach the port in a given deployment: that is an integrator's network question
